comment: Renderer-neutral look values neither the lighting bible (lighting-bible.json) nor the rain pack (rain-bible.json) fixes, tuned for the owner's phone checks. Both renderers read them from here; nothing look-related is hard-coded in shaders or Swift (owner, 6 Oct). Change log: docs/look-spec-changes.md.

wetPaving.comment: Departure from rain-v1 (owner's phone check, 7 Oct): the pack's paving darkening x3.8, so steady rain darkens concrete ~38% and asphalt ~42%, light rain ~30%.

houseContrast.comment: Generator (P2), house-details families: house-contrast-v1 (R approved, binding) per house type, read by key from Profiles/mock-values.json (generated by Tools/lookloop/compile_mocks.py; one source): trim, roof and daytime glass colours; soffit and porch-underside colours on down-facing faces; the eave/cornice shadow band fading to eave_shadow.relativeBrightness (wall = 1) at the eave line or parapet top. Walls stay observed/profile colours. families: P2 mapping of house families to the pack's four types by type and wall material (docs/buildings/README.md); 'flat' = two- or three-flat by storeys. eaveBandHeight is the existing near wall band (geometry), not a pack value. brickWallFamilies: Chicago brick families whose walls take one of the pack's three brick wall swatches (three-flat, two-flat, bungalow), seeded per building (variation between buildings, owner 7 Oct), unless building:colour is mapped; their windows get the stone lintel/sill openings in the type's trim, a reveal strip in the soffit colour, and a foundation course in the trim colour (stone base).
